capture_scope.note: All assertions use synthetic tool declarations and history; no real call IDs, item IDs, task paths, or tokens are retained.

cases.description: Native Responses endpoint with namespace_lifecycle=True receives the collaboration V2 namespace unchanged and round-trips SSE/terminal events.
Native V2 history survives request encoding and response decoding byte-equivalently.
Responses endpoint without namespace_lifecycle triggers injective, request-scoped aliases and reversible decode.
Identical declaration shapes produce disjoint alias sets across separate request tokens.
Fragmented function_call_arguments.delta events reassemble and terminal response.completed reconciles on alias wire.
Adapted stream preserves upstream output order through SSE and terminal envelope.
Mixed V1/V2 tool declarations are rejected before upstream sampling.
Mixed V1/V2 history items are rejected before upstream sampling.
V1-style parameters on a V2 function_call are rejected.
Native V2 spawn_agent missing namespace is rejected.
Duplicate call_id values in V2 history are rejected.
V2 function_call missing call_id is rejected.
agent_message with disallowed content variant is rejected.
Orphan function_call_output with no matching call is rejected.
V1 multi_agent_v1 state mixed into V2 history is rejected.
V2 list_agents result carrying pagination fields is rejected.
Gateway never synthesizes function_call_output or completion items.
V2 contexts do not initialize V1 scheduler, worker stream binding, or spawn-allowed state.
